summary: Small thiscall dispatcher keyed on the control value *a2. When *a2 is 0, forwards to StructInitWithSubCall(this, a2[1], a3) and returns its result immediately. When *a2 is 1, calls sub_452B10(this, a2[1], a3 == 2); if that returns non-zero, returns DeviceObjectSelector(this, a2[1]). Otherwise returns *a2 - 1.

local_names.a2: control/parameter record; a2[0] is the dispatch key, a2[1] is a payload passed to the callees
local_names.a3: integer argument; its equality with 2 is coerced to a boolean for sub_452B10

operations.description: Dispatch on *a2: a zero control value selects the initialization path, a value of 1 selects the compute-and-select path.
When *a2 == 0, call StructInitWithSubCall(this, a2[1], a3) and return its result immediately.
Fallback result initialized to *a2 - 1; this is also the default return when neither dispatch branch fires.
Only when *a2 == 1 does the compute-and-select branch execute.
Call sub_452B10(this, a2[1], a3 == 2), coercing the comparison a3 == 2 into a boolean third argument.
The device-selection step only runs when sub_452B10 returned non-zero.
When the sub_452B10 result is non-zero, return DeviceObjectSelector(this, a2[1]).
Return the computed result (the initialization call result, the selector result, or *a2 - 1).

unresolved: The meaning of the control values in a2[0] (0 = init, 1 = compute-and-select) and the payload a2[1] is not established by this packet.
Why the a3 == 2 comparison is coerced to a boolean for sub_452B10 is unknown.
The owning object and the device-selection domain are unidentified.
